blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: BRP tests whether ACC is non-negative; BRZ tests zero; BRA is unconditional.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Load the counter, output it and subtract one. Test BRP immediately: save the new value and loop only when it is non-negative.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: After outputting 0, SUB ONE underflows; BRP is not taken, so HLT runs without storing a negative mailbox value.
